name: Snapper
tagline: Screenshots, annotated and shared in seconds.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Snapper records your voice with a screen recording when you turn the microphone on. The sound stays in the recording on this Mac.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Snapper shows your camera in a bubble in a screen recording when you turn the camera on. Nothing else is recorded or kept.
